progression.description:
- **full**: Full spell slot progression (e.g. Wizard, Cleric, Druid).
- **half**: Half spell slot progression (e.g. Paladin, Ranger).
- **pact**: Warlock pact magic with short-rest slot recovery.

preparation.description:
- **prepared**: The caster prepares a subset of spells from their class list after a long rest (e.g. Cleric, Wizard).
- **known**: The caster knows a fixed set of spells that expands as they gain levels (e.g. Bard, Sorcerer).
- **full_list**: The entire applicable class spell list is available without daily prepared-subset selection (class-wide mode). Per-spell always-prepared grants use grant availability instead.

__schema1.description:
- **str**: Physical might
- **dex**: Agility, reflexes, and balance
- **con**: Health and stamina
- **int**: Reasoning and memory
- **wis**: Perceptiveness and mental fortitude
- **cha**: Force of personality

unlock.description: When this group unlocks. Omit for the default group (granted when the trait or feature is first gained).

grants.description: Atomic grants that unlock together. At least one grant is required.

__schema18.description:
- **walk**: Walk Speed is how far a creature can move on foot across open ground during its turn (e.g. 30 feet for most Medium humanoids).
- **fly**: Fly Speed is how far a creature can move through the air. A creature without a Fly Speed cannot stay aloft unless a rule grants flight.
- **swim**: Swim Speed is how far a creature can move through water. Without a Swim Speed, moving in water costs extra movement.
- **climb**: Climb Speed is how far a creature can move while climbing. Without a Climb Speed, climbing costs extra movement.
- **burrow**: Burrow Speed is how far a creature can move by tunneling through earth or loose material.

__schema44.description:
- **origin**: A feat taken at character creation or when a feature grants an Origin feat choice.
- **general**: A feat typically taken at level 4+ when a class grants a General feat choice.
- **fighting-style**: A feat granted by the Fighting Style feature or similar class features.
- **epic-boon**: A high-level feat typically taken at level 19+.

__schema54.description:
- **weapon**: A weapon item such as a sword, bow, or thrown weapon.
- **armor**: Armor or a shield used for protection.
- **adventuring_gear**: General equipment used while adventuring.
- **tool**: A tool set, kit, game set, or musical instrument.
- **mount**: A rideable animal or similar mount.
- **vehicle**: A land or water vehicle.
- **service**: A purchasable service.
- **magic_item**: A magical item such as a potion, scroll, or wondrous item.

__schema67.description: - **always_prepared**: The spell is always on the character prepared list for this grant; cast with normal spell slots unless a separate free-cast entitlement applies.

frequency.description:
- **at_will**: You can use this ability at will, without expending a limited use.
- **once_per_long_rest**: You can use this ability once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.
- **prof_bonus_per_long_rest**: You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
